## Checklist

- [ ] `sh scripts/check.sh` passes (the same checks CI runs: shell scripts, formatting, clippy, tests, licences, cargo audit, release self-test)
- [ ] It's either a behaviour change or a pure refactor, not both in one pull request
- [ ] New source files start with `SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later`, and I agree my contribution is under that licence
- [ ] Every new setting has a plain-English `why`
- [ ] `tested = true` only if I tested it myself on real hardware
